description:
Approved by the user 2026-11-17 (relayed by the JSON session). Proposal page first, before any build.

Native has two implementations of guard lowering:
- src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs lowers function-clause guards to native IR: lower_guard_expr, lower_guard_boolean, lower_guard_short_circuit, lower_guard_extern, lower_guard_dispatch(_node), lower_guard_binop (~3690-4060, ~6126).
- src/compiler2/native_codegen/receive.rs emits receive guards straight to Cranelift with a parallel set: emit_dispatch_guard_expr, emit_guard_boolean, emit_short_circuit_guard, emit_guard_extern, emit_guard_dispatch(_node), leave_guard, fail_guard (~1241-1865).

Evidence: fz-nml.9.1 (#692) had to apply the same join-lane rule twice (a type union in native.rs, a hand-written lane check in receive.rs); its first attempt fixed one copy and the count did not move.
Cause: receive dispatch is emitted by its own Cranelift emitter (emit_receive_dispatch_body), not through native lowering.

The page answers whether receive guard expressions can go through the same lowering as function-clause guards, and what the receive emitter needs in exchange (subjects read from the message, out-slots, park).
Removal ledger: the receive.rs guard emitters.
Overlap: Optimize's unfiled proposal A (one continuation closure per receive, terminator.rs build_park_record) touches the same receive lowering; sequence the two.

comments.text: Done-when also (Binary Handling, develop 9c9a39e8a): a receive guard comparing against a binary literal compiles natively. send(self(), {:m, "ab"}); receive do {:m, b} when b == "ab" -> IO.inspect(:eq); _ -> IO.inspect(:ne) end prints :eq on interp but fails on run and build with 'codegen: guard const Utf8Binary([97, 98]) cannot be materialized in receive dispatch' (native_codegen/receive.rs:1411; dispatch_const_value has no binary arm), at any length. One guard lowering removes it; the repro joins this ticket's oracle fixture on all three paths.

title: A guard is lowered once: receive dispatch reuses native guard lowering
